observations.seen: Warm, soft daylight reads correctly as outdoor-day. Key direction is weak: the boulders and trees show little form-defining light/shadow contrast, and the scene looks mostly ambient-lit.

There is almost no contact shadow under the character's feet on the log. The log casts no clear shadow on the dirt path. The boulders and trees sit on the grass with faint or missing grounding shadows.
All surfaces are matte. Nothing shows environment reflection or specular response, not even the character's clothing or the sandstone. There is no sky-tinted fill on upward faces.

A dirt path leads to a sea horizon, with low-poly trees, cracked boulders and a textured sandstone cliff. The grass fields are flat, uniform green dotted with small purple tetrahedron pebbles, which reads as sparse placeholder scatter.
Distance haze softens the horizon and the far trees. A large dark storm cloud and a pale haze band sit in the sky. The fog is present but slightly heavy and grey, which mutes the sky blue.

The foreground log is a smooth brown gradient with no bark texture and visible vertical segment seams. The cliff and boulders have decent painted textures. The grass has no texture variation, so material fidelity is inconsistent.

The log is a plain low-segment cylinder with faceted ends. The trees are low-poly with faceted canopy cards. The character is a reasonable stylized figure with sculpted curly hair. Asset fidelity is mixed across the scene.

The path's leading lines converge well on the horizon. The large log fills most of the bottom third and is cut off, and the menu UI overlaps the left tree cluster. The character is small, about 15–20% of frame height.

The camera is a behind-and-above chase view looking down the path, not the side-on follow view the platformer recipe expects. The FOV looks close to 50. The subject occupies under the target 18–25% of the frame.
The tone mapping is soft and warm, but the overall image is slightly washed and low-contrast, with greens less saturated than the recipe calls for. No visible bloom, AO or sharpening adds depth.

The title typography is clean, with an orange kicker and a cream headline. The rounded buttons have clear hierarchy, and the gold Play button ties to the accent color. A readable keycap control strip runs along the bottom.

nextChange.change: raise shadow strength toward the look target and pull the key light to an angle that throws visible contact shadows
